With your free Gemini key, Kitra translates with the highest accuracy: it understands context, idioms and tone. Without a key, Kitra uses a basic mode that works on your phone, but translations may be inaccurate.
You can set it up later in the settings.
It is free and takes about two minutes.
Tap the button and sign in with your Google account.
Tap Create API key and then the copy button.
Kitra detects the key automatically. You only have to confirm.
Not detected? Paste the key here
From now on Kitra translates with Gemini. Your key is stored encrypted on this phone.
The key is saved, but it has no free quota left right now. Kitra will use it as soon as it renews.

When you tap “Translate”, Kitra sends the screenshot directly to Google with your key. On the free tier of the Gemini API, Google may use what you send to improve its products, and human reviewers may read it. Do not translate sensitive information with a free key. With billing enabled (paid tier), Google does not use it to improve its products.
Google says this key is not valid. Go back to AI Studio, tap the copy button next to your key and come back here.
Google rejected this type of key. This is a known Google issue with some new keys. Try creating another key in AI Studio; meanwhile Kitra keeps working in basic mode.
There is no internet connection. Connect and try again.
The key works, but the configured model is not available for it. Reset the model in Advanced.
Google is not responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
Take a screenshot and tap “Translate”. That is all.
Gemini is on: Kitra translates with your key and the highest accuracy.
Basic mode: translations may be inaccurate. Set up your free Gemini key for accurate translations.
For basic mode and offline use, Kitra downloads this language once.
It will download when there is Wi‑Fi (about 30 MB).
The language could not be downloaded.
It will download the first time it is needed (about 30 MB).
Notice when you take a screenshot
Kitra detects your new screenshots and shows a “Translate” notice for a few seconds. It never saves, moves or deletes your screenshots.
Notice when you save an image
When a new image appears (for example, a screenshot), Kitra shows a “Translate” notice. Tap it and choose the image: Kitra only sees the image you choose.
It needs permission to see your photos (only to detect new screenshots) and to show notifications.
You allowed access to only some photos, so Kitra cannot see new screenshots. Choose “Allow all” in Photos and videos, or share images with Kitra.
Permission denied. You can turn it on in the system settings, or share any image with Kitra.
Notifications are off for Kitra. Turn them on in the system settings.
Ready. Take a screenshot to try it.
Share any image with Kitra to translate it, even if it is not a screenshot.

• With your Gemini key, the screenshot is sent directly to Google (Gemini API) only when you tap “Translate”. On the free tier, Google may use it to improve its products and human reviewers may read it.\n• In basic mode, the screenshot and its text never leave your phone. Google’s on-device components (ML Kit) send technical diagnostics to Google, never the image or the text.\n• Kitra has no servers of its own and no analytics, and it does not store screenshots or translations.
Which engines are available and which one was used for each translation.
Without Gemini, Kitra translates on the phone: with Gemini Nano if the phone has it, otherwise with Google’s on-device translator (ML Kit).
Gemini Nano: available on this phone.
Gemini Nano: can be downloaded (managed by the system).
Gemini Nano: not available on this phone.
Default: %1$s. Only change it if you know what you are doing.
